### Historical audit

**Source:** S0180, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r2/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_155212263/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to its JSONL lines and character ranges.

| Question | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | The instructed goal was an editable reconstruction of an indoor photograph using separate SceneAct meshes, matching viewpoint, framing, objects, occlusions, colors and materials; the reference image itself is not visible in this audit. This is the task goal, not evidence that it was achieved (student `model_request`, line 1, chars [0,9034)). |
| Actual operations and changes | A fresh, read-only student CLI session was launched with an image and tools disabled. It failed with exit code 1 after about 19.4 seconds; the session reports zero tool calls (student `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2633)). No program, scene edit, build, or render is visible. This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure or an empty patch. |
| Validation and outcome | The student `model_error` points to a stderr log, whose contents are not supplied; `scene_error` traces the exception through the policy’s request to the CLI wrapper (lines 3–4, chars [0,552) and [0,1613)). No visual validation, successful build, score, or final submission is shown. The ultimate outcome beyond this interruption is unknown. |
| Scene-specific checks | The request calls for multiple objects, separate materials, composite parts, camera and lighting, but there is no generated scene or rendered image with which to verify object count, textures, connections, pose, camera, lighting, or render quality. Specific defects cannot be diagnosed from the trace (line 1, chars [0,9034); lines 2–4, ranges above). |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or execution of teacher advice appears; receipt and adoption are therefore not evidenced. The session reports no tool calls, and no autonomous exploration or correction is visible (lines 1–4, ranges above). |

**Transferable lesson and uncertainty:** A failed model invocation provides no usable render for visual critique; the actionable next diagnostic would be the actual stderr content, not speculation about scene geometry. Whether the failure was environmental, model-service-related, or caused by another issue remains unresolved. Any particular reference-scene objects or reconstruction defects would be task-specific hypotheses unsupported by the supplied evidence.
